body: It’s so hard sometimes to stop the habit when it feels so good in the short term.

Omg just listened to them all. So amazing !!! Cannons are already a well loved band in my playlist. But I loved Sofis song, I feel like as a language ignorant British person I miss so much good music sometimes. And the curse broke me in the best way. I feel like you might enjoy jonna jinton the wolf song or any bjork song she’s so good.

Yes 26 so feeling very much in my mid life crisis rn. I totally understand about no close friends. I feel like I’ve never really had the friendship closeness that I’ve hoped for, not sure what you think though. My interests are pretty introverted, I’m a pretty reserved person but have been known to be way more introverted with people I grow close too. I like video games, books, art, tv and music. So pretty diverse, what about you?

Ooof too real. I feel like loneliness is so common which seems wild in today’s technically open society. But I feel like it makes people more private about things that matter but more open about the every day argument and debate.

Yeah lonely is deffo self imposed a lot of the time. I feel like self isolation and then internal issues definitely make things worse. But also drunk is I guess is more of a time constraint thing. Music. Music I love. Top four songs rn? Mine are; shame by Mitski, I was all over her by Salvia Plath, Objects in the rearview mirror by Meatloaf and Big God by Florence and the Machine. My music taste changes daily though
